name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad discovered his passion for motorsport at a young age, tinkering with go-karts in his neighborhood. This early fascination led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, Ahmad secured a junior role at a local racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for data analysis and performance optimization. He joined CRG Racing Team two years ago, focusing on suspension tuning and aerodynamic improvements. Ahmad's calm and methodical approach, coupled with his talent for identifying subtle performance gains, makes him a valuable asset to the team.

Ahmad's colleagues frequently praise his ability to remain composed under pressure. He's known for his rigorous data-driven approach, often spending hours poring over telemetry to extract actionable insights. While some might find this tedious, Ahmad thrives on the challenge of finding that extra tenth of a second. He's also a dedicated team player, always willing to share his knowledge and assist his colleagues in tackling complex problems.

What sets Ahmad apart is his deep understanding of the interplay between vehicle dynamics and driver feedback. He's particularly skilled at translating driver's observations into tangible adjustments that improve both performance and driver confidence. His commitment to continuous learning and his unwavering focus on results make him a rising star in the world of motorsport engineering.

physical.description: Ahmad has a lean build and a focused expression, often seen with a thoughtful frown.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of data logging software, claiming it provides more reliable results.
